about: EVERY NUMBER AND NAME IN THIS FILE IS A PLACEHOLDER until club staff and the bookkeeper confirm the real ones (see CLAUDE.md). Money is in cents (15450 is $154.50). duesCents: monthly dues for each membership type; the Resident and Intermediate amounts are the ones on the public Membership page, and the Non-Resident amount is invented because the public page only says to ask. visitorFreePerDay and visitorFeeCents: a member can bring that many visitors in one day for free; with more than that, every visitor that day costs the fee. visitorsPerEntryMax and visitorsPerDayMax: the most visitors one entry, and one member in one day, can record. invoiceDueDays: days from the invoice date to the due date. items: the product or service name each kind of line goes under in QuickBooks; these must match the names in QuickBooks exactly. taxable: kinds of line that carry sales tax. QuickBooks' own invoice import cannot take tax, so this shows in the plain charges file only.
